scope: Pixel comparison of source_phase 0 only for Ballerina PEARL MIRROR, Magician VANISH and Pop Star SOUND CHECK, practice and stage, baseline run04 versus candidate05. Scores cover only the changed focus-lens presentation and Magician pose containment.

candidate_source.description: 37-line world repair: suppress activity focus bloom/arc only when two_act_enabled while retaining pearls; add Hall-scoped Magician phase pose holds.

baseline_disposition: run04 imagery is valid comparison evidence. Its overall FAIL came from a bad harness oracle expecting pose_round 0 although accepted input correctly advanced it to 1; this does not invalidate the pixels. Candidate05 uses the corrected round_before+1 oracle.
limits: configured-route desktop Mobile 1280x720 capture, not natural navigation or target-device evidence
three stills per part do not establish full animation cadence or transition quality
later source phases and broad scene quality remain open
no score is averaged into whole-game or whole-career acceptance

Ballerina.finding: Removing the dark bloom and long cyan arc restores the painted garden/stage values and makes all three pose portraits easier to compare. The retained pearl/progress markers and large cream targets provide enough task framing; no material readability loss is visible. The pointer still covers part of the large target portrait, and actor/stage contact remains below bar, so this is not full 4.5 acceptance.

Magician.finding: The lamb, hat, wand and cabinets remain visible without the dark right-half mask, and the stage spotlight/value structure becomes legible. The small local wand ring and payoff rings still identify the active prop, so removing the global lens does not erase task focus. Prop contact/order and flat payoff particles remain separate defects.

Pop Star.finding: Removal restores the right practice booth and the full stage note ribbon/dance-pad colours. The local microphone highlight, active note, sound waves, progress panel and retained pearls still protect the SOUND CHECK objective. Practice microphone scale/location and stage DANCE-pad competition remain below-bar issues outside this repair.

changed_focus_lens_review.panel_protection: KEEP_CURRENT_TOP_PANEL_AND_LOCAL_TARGET_FEEDBACK. The header remains high-contrast and unobstructed in all candidate stills. No replacement global bloom is needed; any further focus treatment should remain local to the active prop and must not dim the painted room.

magician_pose_containment.finding: Candidate05 keeps VANISH in wand/orbit magic imagery during intro/contact. Baseline contact could show the separate portal trick, so the candidate no longer visibly introduces that unrelated trick during the held VANISH action. Cheer playback was unchanged; baseline/candidate payoff cells differ only because the samples landed at different points in the same existing cheer loop and provide no repair evidence.
magician_pose_containment.caveat: This supports only visible active phase-state semantics for VANISH and cannot prove animation cadence. Payoff/cheer quality remains temporally unassessed. The remaining four Magician source phases need their own current captures before the five-phase mapping can be accepted.

final_disposition: KEEP_BOTH_BOUNDED_REPAIRS. They materially improve first-phase readability, scene ownership and Magician semantic containment without visible loss of objective guidance. Whole scenes remain below or incompletely evidenced in other dimensions and later phases remain OPEN.
